question: Which individual sages are named as participants in the consecration?
premises: Sanatkumāra, Sanaka, and Sanantana are named.
They are listed as part of the invoked assembly.
inference: Specific renowned sages are individually invoked to participate in the consecration.
plain_english: May Bhṛgu, Sanatkumāra, Sanaka, and then Sanantana take part.
